```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false
library(tidymodels)
library(here)
library(readr)

set.seed(123)

source(here("shared", "02_preprocessing.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: qwk-metric
qwk <- metric_tweak("qwk", kap, weighting = "quadratic")
f_macro <- metric_tweak("f_macro", f_meas, estimator = "macro")
grade_metrics <- metric_set(qwk, accuracy, f_macro, roc_auc)
```

## Model

```{r}
#| label: model-spec
multinomial_spec <- multinom_reg() |>
  set_engine("nnet") |>
  set_mode("classification")

log_reg_workflow <- workflow() |>
  add_model(multinomial_spec) |>
  add_recipe(base_recipe)
```

## Cross-validation

```{r}
#| label: cv-fit
set.seed(123)
log_reg_resamples <- fit_resamples(
  log_reg_workflow,
  resamples = folds,
  metrics = grade_metrics,
  control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
)

cv_metrics <- collect_metrics(log_reg_resamples)
cv_metrics
```

### Per-class CV metrics

Precision, recall, and F1 for each damage grade use pooled out-of-fold predictions from the shared folds.

```{r}
#| label: per-class-cv
cv_pred <- collect_predictions(log_reg_resamples)
cm_tbl <- conf_mat(cv_pred, damage_grade, estimate = .pred_class)$table

cv_per_class <- map_dfr(rownames(cm_tbl), function(cls) {
  tp <- cm_tbl[cls, cls]
  fp <- sum(cm_tbl[cls, ]) - tp
  fn <- sum(cm_tbl[, cls]) - tp
  tibble(
    class = cls,
    precision = tp / (tp + fp),
    recall = tp / (tp + fn),
    f_meas = 2 * tp / (2 * tp + fp + fn)
  )
})

cv_per_class
```

### Save CV results

```{r}
#| label: save-cv-results
#| include: false
metrics_dir <- here("results", "metrics")
dir.create(metrics_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cv_metrics |>
  mutate(model = "multinomial_logistic") |>
  write_csv(file.path(metrics_dir, "chang_multinomial_logistic_cv.csv"))

cv_per_class |>
  mutate(model = "multinomial_logistic") |>
  write_csv(file.path(metrics_dir, "chang_multinomial_logistic_cv_per_class.csv"))
```
